B1_race_nulls.null_definition: role labels (instruct vs abliterated) are permuted WITHIN each lineage, the identical leave-one-lineage-out balanced-accuracy pipeline is re-run on every permutation, and the 95th percentile of the permuted BA is the bar (analysis2.py:label_permutation_null L501-535, called with group=primary holdout=lineage, n_perm=min(n_perm,300), pipeline2.py L1402-1403)
B1_race_nulls.primary_holdout: leave-one-LINEAGE-out (gate G2 FAMILY_AXIS_DEGRADED: fewer than 5 families carry an instruct/abliterated pair)

logo_null_calibration.design: 6 groups x 4 checkpoints, balanced random labels, random features, 200 draws
logo_null_calibration.note: leave-one-group-out BA on uninformative labels sits near 0.40, not 0.50

B1_race_nulls.naming_note: the per_checkpoint_predictions column called 'anisonull' in race.json is a FEATURE permutation (x values shuffled once, pipeline2.py L1387-1390), used only for display; it is not an anisotropy null and not the null behind any race claim
B1_race_nulls.old_wording: family / anisotropy-matched null (paper wording flagged by the iter-3 review)
B1_race_nulls.new_wording: within-lineage label-permutation null: role labels (instruct vs abliterated) are permuted WITHIN each lineage, the identical leave-one-lineage-out balanced-accuracy pipeline is re-run on every permutation, and the 95th percentile of the permuted BA is the bar (analysis2.py:label_permutation_null L501-535, called with group=primary holdout=lineage, n_perm=min(n_perm,300), pipeline2.py L1402-1403)

table.contrast: harmful vs plain_benign, last prompt token (primary read)

table.readout: iter-2 exp1 harm direction at depth 0.6 (probe_cf harvest)
table.contrast: harmful vs benign (plain+alarming), exp1 G8 gate
table.null: within-item-span random direction, 1000 draws/tier, sign fixed on train folds

table.contrast: harmful vs all benign incl. contrast

null_definitions.span: within-item-span random direction: centred TRAIN-fold activations times a Gaussian vector, unit-normed, sign fixed on train folds, scored out of fold (d2_controls.py:_draw 'span')
null_definitions.aniso: anisotropy-matched random direction: Ledoit-Wolf covariance square-root applied to an isotropic draw
null_definitions.perm: label-permutation null on the fitted cross-fitted direction (B_perm=1000)
null_definitions.white: LDA-whitened refit scored against its OWN within-span null

B2_direction_nulls.print_together_note: 16/17, 17/17, 9/17 and 9/20 are always printed together; they are different contrasts/readouts/panels, not replications of one number
B2_direction_nulls.reconciliation: 9/20 (exp1, 20 checkpoints incl. base models, harmful vs ALL benign at probe layer) and 16/17 (eval1, 17 checkpoints, harmful vs plain_benign at fixed depth 0.6, last token) use different panels, contrasts and item sets; the 9/17 is the FIRST-token readout

lineage_bootstrap_ci95.note: only 4 lineages: the CI is a descriptive band, not inference

B3_above_chance.sentence: About 38% of the harm direction's above-chance AUROC is reachable by a random direction inside the item span, and whitening removes about 23%.
